title: Log in with a passkey and read the fingerprint to the conductor
summary: Open Log in, press "Log in with a passkey", and read the fingerprint shown (sha256: and 16 characters) to the conductor; paste the public half too (it is not secret).
closes: Your public key is in data/keys.json, added by the conductor after you read the fingerprint.
blocks: Nothing can be sealed to you, and your feedback cannot be told from anyone else's.
